title: The Real Story Behind Timber + Love: What We’ve Built and Why It Matters

blocks.text: Timber + Love started out as a hands-on real estate and renovation practice in Boise. It grew from there into the design-build firm Luke Caldwell and his team run today.

Before the HGTV cameras, Luke was buying houses in the Treasure Valley, renovating them and learning the craft from the ground up. Renovating turned into wanting to design and build things that last. Every project had to be handled with care and a clear idea of what it was for.

On a lot of jobs the designers and the builders work separately, and things get lost between them. Timber + Love runs the whole design-build process under one roof instead. When designers and builders are on one team, fewer things get lost between the drawing and the job site.
The team is designers, skilled tradespeople and project managers who care about the details: the materials, how the work gets done and how long it lasts. We prefer to hire local when we can.
When Boise Boys went national, a lot more people saw our work: bold designs that still work for real life. Viewers liked the transformations and the people behind them.
Today we still design and build custom homes and renovations, and some commercial design. We care about the people as much as the buildings, and we try to make spaces that fit how their owners live.
